description: Verify that a user can successfully log in using Google OAuth authentication and is redirected to their dashboard.
steps: Verify that the Google sign-in option is visible and enabled.
Click on the Google sign-in button.
Verify that the Google OAuth login page is displayed.
Enter valid Google credentials (email and password) on the Google login page.
Click the 'Next' or 'Sign In' button on the Google login page.
Verify that the user is redirected back to the Roost application.
Check that the user lands on their dashboard at https://dev.roost.ai.
Verify that the user's dashboard displays active environments and relevant user data.
expected_results: The user is authenticated via Google OAuth.
The user is redirected to the dashboard page at https://dev.roost.ai.
The dashboard displays user-specific data such as active environments.
edge_cases: User cancels the Google OAuth process mid-way.
Session timeout occurs before authentication is completed.
data_requirements: Valid Google OAuth client ID and redirect URI.
dependencies: Google OAuth service must be operational.
Roost backend must handle OAuth tokens correctly.
The user's Google account must be active and in good standing.
api_interactions: Roost API to fetch user-specific data after login.
performance_metrics: Time taken to redirect back to the dashboard after login.
Page load time for the dashboard.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the Google sign-in button is keyboard accessible.
Verify that screen readers can announce the Google sign-in option.
Ensure color contrast ratios meet WCAG standards for the sign-in button.
Verify that focus order is logical and intuitive.
